zh.title: 王碧豪 Bihao Wang · Oratis | 在线简历
zh.description: 王碧豪，心影随形联合创始人，AI 产品创业者与开源开发者。探索 LISA、TakoAPI、GPTwiki、Markup 和 DeepCode，以及逗逗游戏伙伴、HakkoAI 与 Cuddler 的创业实践。
zh.role: AI 产品创业者 · 开源开发者
zh.name: 王碧豪
headline: 让 AI 走进
真实生活。
zh.intro: 我是 Bihao Wang，也叫 Oratis。心影随形联合创始人，长期专注 AI 伙伴、视频生态与商业化，也亲手构建开源工具。
zh.heroNote: 从产品设计到技术架构，从第一位用户到全球市场。
zh.nowText: AI 伙伴、创作者生态与个人智能工具
zh.projectsTitle:
把想法做成
用得上的产品。
zh.projectsIntro: 我关注人与 AI 如何长期协作，也关注每天使用的工具能否更顺手。下面是我在 GitHub 上持续构建的五个项目。

projectData.name: LISA
projectData.description: 为日常计划、写作和个人知识管理而生。支持云端使用，也可运行在自己的 Mac 上，连接模型、工具与开发工作流。

projectData.name: TakoAPI
projectData.description: 通过统一 API 发现和调用 AI Agent，把开放的 Agent 目录、网关与编码技能生态连接起来。

projectData.name: GPTwiki
projectData.description: 在与 AI 的对话中创建和完善知识，让零散的问题与思考，沉淀成可以协作建设的百科内容。

projectData.name: Markup
projectData.description: 像浏览网页一样阅读 Markdown，需要时再进入编辑。原生轻量体验，支持知识库、双向链接与全文搜索。

projectData.name: DeepCode
projectData.description: 面向真实代码库的开源编程助手。围绕读取、编辑、命令执行、MCP 和可恢复会话构建，持续完善 CLI 与桌面体验。

zh.aboutTitle:
保持好奇，
亲手创造。
zh.aboutText: 我习惯在产品、技术和商业之间来回走动：理解用户的实际需要，拆解增长问题，再把想法做出来。从 2010 年开始独立开发 iOS 应用，到今天持续参与开源，这种工作方式一直没有改变。

en.title: Bihao Wang · Oratis | Résumé
en.description: Bihao Wang, co-founder of 心影随形, AI product entrepreneur and open-source builder. Explore LISA, TakoAPI, GPTwiki, Markup, DeepCode, Doudou, HakkoAI and Cuddler.
en.name: Bihao Wang
headline: Making AI part
of everyday life.
en.intro: I'm Bihao Wang, also known as Oratis. As co-founder of 心影随形, I build AI companions and video ecosystems, grow businesses, and create open-source tools.
en.heroNote: From product design to architecture. From the first user to global markets.
en.nowText: AI companions, creator ecosystems & personal AI tools
en.projectsIntro: I explore how people and AI work together over time, while building tools that make everyday work a little better. Five projects I build in the open.

projectData.name: LISA
projectData.description: An assistant for planning, writing and personal knowledge. Use LISA in the cloud or on your Mac, with your choice of models, tools and development workflows.

projectData.name: TakoAPI
projectData.description: Discover and invoke AI agents through one API. An open agent directory and unified gateway, connected to an ecosystem of coding skills.

projectData.name: GPTwiki
projectData.description: Create and enrich knowledge through conversations with AI, turning questions and ideas into an encyclopedia people can build together.

projectData.name: Markup
projectData.description: Read Markdown like a web page, then edit on demand. A lightweight native app with a knowledge vault, backlinks and full-text search.

projectData.name: DeepCode
projectData.description: An open-source coding agent for real repositories. Read, edit, run commands and connect MCP tools, with resumable sessions and evolving CLI and desktop experiences.

en.founderText: I lead product design, operations, marketing, public relations and technical architecture, turning AI capabilities into useful experiences and sustainable businesses.

ventures.name: Doudou
ventures.text: Built the world's No. 1 AI gaming companion, reaching more than 20 million users.
ventures.caption: Users

ventures.name: HakkoAI
ventures.text: Doudou's international version, with annual recurring revenue in the multi-million US dollar range.
ventures.caption: ARR

ventures.name: Cuddler
ventures.text: Building cuddler.ai, an AI video ecosystem platform with rapidly growing annual recurring revenue.
ventures.caption: AI video platform ARR

en.metricsNote: Venture metrics and market-position claims are founder-reported, updated November 2026.
en.experienceIntro: From international video and search advertising to creator ecosystems and AI entrepreneurship.

experience.text: Lead product design, operations, marketing, public relations and technical architecture across Doudou, HakkoAI and Cuddler.

experience.role: Head of Ecosystem Commerce Business Center
experience.text: Led a 30-person team, expanding creator promotion into local services, frontline recruitment, online education and mini-games.
Led a 35-person team responsible for advertising products and platforms, native video ads and creator revenue sharing.
Served as senior manager for search advertising, then product director for mobile advertising, improving retrieval, creative formats and conversion funnels.
Built international video products, then worked on mobile brand ads, feed monetization and rich-media search ads. Launched VideoBox in Arabic-speaking markets.

en.aboutText: I work across product, technology and business: understanding real needs, making sense of growth, and turning ideas into working products. I've built independent iOS apps since 2010. Open source is a continuation of that hands-on approach.
en.education: Beijing Foreign Studies University · Bachelor's degree · 2009–2013
aboutNotes: Early independent apps reached over 500,000 cumulative installs.
Internet and gaming content creator; former guest instructor at Qidian Academy.
en.contactTitle:
Let's talk about
what's worth building next.
en.contactText: AI products, open-source collaboration, creator ecosystems and global markets.

projectData.category: MACOS 用 MARKDOWN エディタ

projectData.category: DEEPSEEK コーディングエージェント
